verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents service accounts for programmatic access to 'the SigNoz API' for CI/CD, automation scripts and external integrations, and its dashboard docs refer to an API path and dashboards-as-code. Agent access is also documented through an official MCP server and Agent Skills. However, the pack has no actual API reference (endpoints, auth flow, schemas), and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so the API's existence is shown but not its documentation. Missing for 10: a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, endpoint coverage across traces/logs/metrics/alerts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
